pois.name: Potato Head Beach Club
pois.description: Bali's most iconic beach club: a vast open-air venue with a circular bar, multiple pools, and nightly DJ sets facing the Indian Ocean sunset.

pois.name: KU DE TA
pois.description: Seminyak's original beach club and fine dining landmark. Sunset cocktails, Asian-fusion cuisine, and weekly Saturday Soul sessions.

pois.name: Pura Petitenget
pois.description: Sacred sea temple on Seminyak Beach, part of Bali's spiritual sea-axis connecting Pura Tanah Lot to Pura Uluwatu. Ceremony days draw hundreds of local worshippers.

pois.name: W Bali – Seminyak
pois.description: Design-forward luxury resort steps from the beach. WET pool deck, FIRE restaurant, and the flagship AWAY spa.

pois.name: Métis Restaurant & Gallery
pois.description: Award-winning French-Mediterranean fine dining in a colonial villa surrounded by rice fields. Resident gallery shows rotating Indonesian contemporary art.

pois.name: Sardine
pois.description: Open-air fine dining pavilion overlooking a private rice field. Daily-changing menu built around fresh Jimbaran seafood and local produce.

pois.name: Mama San
pois.description: Colonial-warehouse restaurant and cocktail lounge serving the best pan-Asian small plates in Seminyak. Iconic crispy pork belly and Peking duck.

pois.name: Merah Putih
pois.description: Grand Indonesian fine dining in a soaring modern pavilion. The menu celebrates regional Indonesian cuisine from Aceh to Papua with premium local produce.

pois.name: Revolver Espresso
pois.description: Seminyak's cult specialty coffee shop squeezed into a tiny colonial shopfront. Filter and espresso-based drinks from rotating single-origin beans.

pois.name: La Plancha
pois.description: Colourful beanbag beach bar famous for its vivid parasols, fresh sangria, and front-row sunset views on Seminyak Beach.

pois.name: Seminyak Square
pois.description: Boutique shopping precinct with Bali's top designer labels: Biasa, Magali Pascal, Ciel, and Bamboo Blonde.

pois.name: Unit Seminyak
pois.description: Intimate beach club with a single infinity pool, refined day-bed service, and a compact modern menu.

pois.name: Bikini
pois.description: Seminyak's go-to beach fashion boutique: locally-designed swimwear, cover-ups, sandals, and handmade jewellery.

pois.name: Pro Surf Bali
pois.description: Surf school operating from Seminyak Beach with beginner-to-advanced lessons and private coaching by ISA-certified instructors.

pois.name: Mirror
pois.description: Seminyak's upscale nightclub with underground music, internationally renowned DJs, and a reflective mirrored interior.

pois.name: Biku
pois.description: Afternoon tea and colonial brunch in a century-old Balinese joglo house. 30+ loose-leaf teas, fresh scones, and Indonesian heritage dishes.

pois.name: WOO Bar at W Bali
pois.description: Dramatic overwater cocktail bar at W Bali resort. Sunset ritual, resident DJs, and signature cocktails until 2am.

pois.name: Jamu Traditional Spa
pois.description: Traditional Balinese spa in a garden compound. Signature jamu herbal body wraps, lulur scrubs, and 4-hand massages.

pois.name: Pasar Kerobokan
pois.description: Authentic local wet market north of Seminyak. Fresh tropical produce, local warung breakfasts, and zero tourist prices.
